summary_en: Holding company that oversees and manages activities of Egypt's natural gas industry, from agreements, drilling and exploration to processing, transport, distribution in the domestic market and liquefaction.

name_en: Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality (EOS)
summary_en: National body responsible for preparing and issuing Egyptian standards, quality assurance, conformity assessment, testing and industrial measurements, and for representing Egypt in international and regional standards and quality organisations.
summary_ar: الجهة الوطنية المنوط بها إعداد وإصدار المواصفات القياسية المصرية، وأنشطة توكيد الجودة وتقييم المطابقة والاختبارات والمعايرات الصناعية، وتمثيل مصر في المنظمات الدولية والإقليمية في مجال المواصفات والجودة.
source_name_ar: موقع الهيئة المصرية العامة للمواصفات والجودة

The English site uses three forms of the name (Standardization and Quality / Standards and Quality / Standardization); the first is used. The English page has typos that were not copied.
